verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not lay out a pricing model. The only pricing-page snippet says "Migration to dltHub included" (dlt-docs-19), which says nothing about rates, tiers or per-source cost. The docs describe dlt as an open-source Python library, but nothing documents managed dltHub pricing or any way to estimate what a new source would cost before connecting it. The GitHub Actions free tier belongs to the host platform and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data platform lead, the pricing model is published and predictable — I can estimate what a new source costs before connecting it
